lanes.name: Coordination and spec
lanes.mission: Run the protocol: lanes, the decision log, the generated spec, the dashboard, hooks and CI. Integrate lane branches into main and keep the board honest.
deliverables: Coordination protocol, hooks and CI that make decisions and status mandatory
Live dashboard on GitHub Pages plus an Artifact snapshot
MVP plan and one brief per lane
Integration of lane branches into main before the demo

lanes.name: Data contracts and API
lanes.mission: Own every shape the lanes exchange: the three-emotion profile, calibration, signal frames, detection events, rep sessions, and the app-to-module API. Ship schemas, fixtures, generated types and contract tests first so every other lane can build against fixtures in parallel.
deliverables: Profile v2: exactly three emotions, each with a physiology, focus and language strategy plus an optional anchor
Schemas for calibration, signal frame, detection event and rep session
contracts/: fixtures, TypeScript types and validation tests
contracts/API.md: the module interfaces app, onboarding, sensing and reps call

lanes.name: Onboarding and strategy elicitation
lanes.mission: Turn a first conversation into a confirmed profile: find the person's three top emotions and, for each, the strategy they already use to get there. Capture a short calibration of what each state looks like in their signals.
deliverables: Elicitation flow and prompts that produce a schema-valid three-emotion profile
Calibration step: recall each emotion for about 60 seconds while signals record
Playback of each confirmed strategy in the person's own words

lanes.name: Sensing and detection
lanes.mission: Get signals in and decide when to fire a rep: a deterministic simulator for the demo, a Web Bluetooth heart-rate strap as the real sensor, a manual trigger, and a personal-baseline detector with a gate.
deliverables: Signal adapters: simulator, Web Bluetooth heart-rate service (HR and RR intervals), manual trigger
Personal baseline from calibration and a detector that emits detection events
Gate: consecutive windows, refractory period, optional sham rate

lanes.name: Repetition and conditioning engine
lanes.mission: Install each state as measurable reps: a short rep script per emotion (anchor, physiology, focus, language, rate), anchor conditioning, rep counting, an installed test, and recovery measured against sham.
deliverables: Rep runner that plays a 20 to 40 second sequence per emotion from the profile
Rep log: intensity before and after, time to recover, cue or sham
Installed criterion and the anchor-only test

lanes.name: App experience and demo
lanes.mission: Own what a judge touches: the web app that runs onboarding, calibration, live detection, the rep and progress, wired to the other lanes' modules, plus the three-minute demo script.
deliverables: Web app shell with the five screens and a demo mode driven by the simulator
Integration of onboarding, sensing and reps modules through contracts/
Demo script, pitch notes and a fallback recording
